name: food-map
description: 自托管美食地图：记录餐厅、照片、评分、标签与共享足迹

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.e2e:install: npm --prefix frontend exec playwright install chromium
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
